title: Revenue Dropped 18% vs Forecast
description: Actual hourly revenue fell to ₹123,000 against a predicted target of ₹150,000. Anomaly flag triggered by dynamic standard-deviation thresholds in BigQuery ML.
root_causes: Google Ads campaign spend dropped by 34% due to account daily cap limits being hit.
Mobile checkout error rate elevated to 12.4% (normal baseline is 1.8%).
Stripe payment gateway API latency spike (+1200ms) on European checkout sessions.
recommended_actions: Increase daily cap limit on Google Ads Account.
Inspect checkout logs for mobile browser compatibility errors.
Enable automatic backup payment gateway routing in Stripe config.

title: Mobile Checkout Failure Rate Elevated
description: Checkout failure rates on iOS Safari browsers increased from 1.5% to 5.8%. Flagged by rolling average tracking metrics.
root_causes: JavaScript bundle error in Safari browser parsing ES2022 syntax in checkout.js.
Database connection pool saturation (98% utilization) during peak traffic window.
recommended_actions: Roll back checkout script to version 2.4.1.
Scale database connection pool limit and optimize idle timeouts.
